Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by roistat/react-ui (https://github.com/roistat/react-ui).
Technology stack: react, javascript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: README 标题 roistat-react-UI - библиотека компонентов пользовательского интерфейса，Необходимая экосистема 一栏列 React JS、Webpack、Babel、ES6、Flowtype。安装分两种：git clone 后 npm i，或在现有项目里 npm i @roistat/ui --save，引用写法是 import Button from '@roistat/ui/lib/Button'；启动命令 npm run docs（文档与示例在 localhost:3000）与 npm run storybook（隔离环境里开发组件，localhost:9010）。Основные компоненты 是 Button、Primary Button、TextInput、Modal、Popover，Вспомогательные компоненты 是 Teleport、Placer、Transition、Toggler，后面还贴了一棵 Структура проека 目录树说明每个组件文件夹里 story.jsx / Readme.md 怎么摆。About 侧栏只有 Work in progress，Topics 是 components / elements / react / reactjs / ui / uikit，8 stars、5 forks，最新提交是 4 年前的 Merge pull request #59。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
